Suddenly, an unfamiliar woman holding a camera approaches.
She holds out a business card.

"Ever since she paired up with her Trainer,
her expression looks brighter by the day!"
I won't... give uuup~~!!

Umm... "Monthly Umamusume Journal"?
Are you a magazine reporter?
*pant*... *wheeze*...!
—Excuse me, do you have a moment?

Tracen Academy was buzzing with excitement over the open mock races.
Among the racers, one Umamusume caught everyone's eye.

When I run with all my energy, not only do I get praised,
Trainer gets praised too~...
Yeah, yeah! That makes me so happy too!

Nnngh... Final spuuurt...!
Let's goooooo!

The reason Haru Urara drew so much attention
wasn't because her running was fast or beautiful—

...They're saying so many nice things about me!
Ehehe... Ah! Trainer, they're praising you too!

Trainer!
Hey, how was my time?

"She must have crossed paths with a truly wonderful Trainer."
...It says! Isn't that great, Trainer!

No matter how many times she loses, she keeps running with all her might without getting discouraged.
That spirit captivated everyone watching.

Fufu, sounds good.
I'll pick out some fantastic shots and send them over later!

Whaaat! I wanna see, I wanna see!
What kind of face do I make when I'm running~? I wanna seeee!
Right there, go for it! Urara-chaaan!

Yes. Ever since I saw her at the Debut Race the other day,
I've been cheering for Haru Urara!

Aww! I really thought I had it today~.
I guess I gotta work hard on training again starting tomorrow!
Yeah!

Really?! Ehehe♪ Thank youuu!
...Wait, is that a camera you're holding, Miss?

Ehehe! Thanks for cheering me on!
I lost this time, but I'm definitely taking 1st place next time!
Yes! I took some photos of you running!

...Ehehe♪
All right, I'm gonna try way, way harder!

Haru Urara makes her push from the back!
She's not quite reaching! But Haru Urara refuses to give up!

Woow! I look so cute! Yay!
Ah! My nostrils are huge! So embarrassing!
Goooaaal!!!

Great fight, Urara-chan!
You really gave it your all on the final stretch!
A few days later. Haru Urara and I checked the photos sent by the reporter.

Haru Urara is trailing far behind the pack!
With fierce determination on her face, she's giving it everything she's got!
